ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom NTDS.dit theft via esentutl /vss or ntdsutil IFM on Domain Controller
ucs.description: Detects INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC, G1032) post-compromise harvest of the Active Directory database on a DC. The crew consistently dumps NTDS.dit using either `esentutl.exe /y /vss` against the live hive or `ntdsutil "ac i ntds" ifm "create full <path>"` rather than dropping a binary credential dumper — this gives them the entire forest's NTLM hashes for follow-on PsExec / WMIC lateral movement before encryption.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="esentutl.exe" OR Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe") by host Processes.process_name Processes.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where ((process_name="esentutl.exe" AND match(cmdline,"(?i)/y") AND match(cmdline,"(?i)ntds")) OR (process_name="ntdsutil.exe" AND match(cmdline,"(?i)(ac i ntds|ifm|create full)")))
| search NOT user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime host process_name cmdline parent user count
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("esentutl.exe","ntdsutil.exe")
| where (FileName =~ "esentutl.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/y" and ProcessCommandLine has "ntds")
    or (FileName =~ "esentutl.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/vss" and ProcessCommandLine has "ntds")
    or (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ac i ntds","activate instance ntds","ifm","create full"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| join kind=leftouter (DeviceInfo | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, DeviceCategory, AdditionalFields) by DeviceId) on DeviceId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, DeviceCategory
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ProcName in ("esentutl.exe","ntdsutil.exe")
| where (ProcName == "esentutl.exe" and CommandLine has "ntds" and (CommandLine has "/y" or CommandLine has "/vss"))
    or (ProcName == "ntdsutil.exe" and (CommandLine has "ac i ntds" or CommandLine has "activate instance ntds" or CommandLine has "ifm" or CommandLine has "create full"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: INC Ransom NTDS.dit Dump via esentutl or ntdsutil IFM
id: 7b4f2e1c-3a8d-4f2e-9b1a-incns-ntds-2024
status: experimental
description: Detects INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) NTDS.dit extraction on Domain Controllers using built-in tooling.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/06/01
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
  - https://www.secureworks.com/research/gold-ionic-deploys-inc-ransomware
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_esentutl:
    Image|endswith: '\esentutl.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'ntds'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/y'
      - '/vss'
  selection_ntdsutil:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
  filter_machine_accounts:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_esentutl or selection_ntdsutil) and not filter_machine_accounts
fields:
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
  - Computer
falsepositives:
  - Authorised AD recovery / migration using IFM (rare, should be ticketed)
  - Backup software using esentutl /y (whitelist by parent path)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1032
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 (@Image:(*\esentutl.exe OR *\Esentutl.exe OR *\ESENTUTL.EXE) OR @Image:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\Ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE)) (@CommandLine:(*ntds* OR *NTDS*) AND @CommandLine:(*"/y"* OR *"/vss"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"create full"* OR *"ifm"*)) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(esentutl|ntdsutil)\.exe$/i
| (regex("(?i)esentutl\.exe", field=ImageFileName) AND regex("(?i)ntds", field=CommandLine) AND regex("(?i)(/y|/vss)", field=CommandLine))
  OR (regex("(?i)ntdsutil\.exe", field=ImageFileName) AND regex("(?i)(ac i ntds|activate instance ntds|ifm|create full)", field=CommandLine))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
ucs.rationale: INC Ransom / GOLD IONIC has been repeatedly observed (Secureworks CTU, Huntress, SentinelOne reporting) skipping common credential-dumper binaries (Mimikatz, ProcDump) in favour of native `esentutl /y /vss` and `ntdsutil ifm` on hijacked Domain Controllers. The combination of (a) the NTDS.dit hive name, (b) the VSS / IFM flag, and (c) an interactive (non-$) account context is essentially never see

ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom MEGA exfiltration: 7-Zip archive staging chained to MEGAcmd / rclone egress to mega.io
ucs.description: Detects INC Ransom's signature double-extortion exfiltration pattern: stage with `7za.exe a` into a multi-volume `.zip`/`.7z` archive, then push to MEGA via MEGAcmd (`MEGAclient.exe`, `mega-put`) or rclone with a `mega:` remote, contacting `api.mega.co.nz` / `*.userstorage.mega.co.nz`. Correlates the staging process and the MEGA network egress on the same host within a 60-minute window to suppress noise from organic MEGA file-sync usage.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as stageTime values(Processes.process) as stageCmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe") Processes.process="*a *" by host Processes.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rename host as src
| join type=inner src [
    | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as exfilTime values(All_Traffic.dest) as exfilDest values(All_Traffic.app) as exfilApp from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest="*mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*userstorage.mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.app IN ("MEGAclient.exe","MEGAsync.exe","mega-put","rclone.exe")) by All_Traffic.src
    | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
    | rename src as src
  ]
| eval deltaSec = exfilTime - stageTime
| where deltaSec >= 0 AND deltaSec <= 3600
| table stageTime exfilTime deltaSec src user stageCmd exfilDest exfilApp count
ucs.kql:
let Window = 60m;
let Stage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s+a\s+"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".zip",".7z","-v","-mx","-p")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project StageTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              StageCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              StageParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let Exfil = union
    (DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
        | where RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.co.nz","mega.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","api.mega.io")
        | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
                  ExfilProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
                  ExfilCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP),
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
        | where FileName in~ ("megaclient.exe","megasync.exe","megacmdserver.exe","mega-put.exe","mega-cmd.exe","rclone.exe")
        | where FileName !=~ "rclone.exe" or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","--remote mega","mega-config")
        | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
                  ExfilProcess = FileName,
                  ExfilCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RemoteUrl = "", RemoteIP = "");
Stage
| join kind=inner Exfil on DeviceId
| where ExfilTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + Window)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ExfilTime, StageTime)
| project StageTime, ExfilTime, DelayMin, DeviceName, AccountName,
          StageCmd, StageParent, ExfilProcess, ExfilCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by StageTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 60m;
let Stage = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ProcName in ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe")
    | where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s+a\s+"
    | where CommandLine has_any (".zip",".7z","-v","-mx","-p")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project StageTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, StageCmd = CommandLine;
let ExfilProc = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ProcName in ("megaclient.exe","megasync.exe","megacmdserver.exe","mega-put.exe","rclone.exe")
    | where ProcName != "rclone.exe" or CommandLine has_any ("mega:","--remote mega")
    | project ExfilTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ExfilProcess = ProcName, ExfilCmd = CommandLine;
let ExfilDns = DnsEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Name has_any ("mega.co.nz","mega.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","api.mega.io")
    | project ExfilTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ExfilProcess = "DNS", ExfilCmd = Name;
let Exfil = union ExfilProc, ExfilDns;
Stage
| join kind=inner Exfil on Computer
| where ExfilTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + Window)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ExfilTime, StageTime)
| project StageTime, ExfilTime, DelayMin, Computer, SubjectUserName, StageCmd, ExfilProcess, ExfilCmd
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\7z.exe OR *\7za.exe OR *\7zg.exe OR *\7Z.EXE OR *\7ZA.EXE) @CommandLine:(*" a "* AND (*.zip* OR *.7z* OR *" -v"* OR *" -mx"* OR *" -p"*)) -@User:*$) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(*mega.co.nz OR *mega.nz OR *userstorage.mega.co.nz OR *api.mega.io)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\MEGAclient.exe OR *\MEGAsync.exe OR *\megacmdserver.exe OR *\mega-put.exe OR *\rclone.exe OR *\MEGAClient.exe OR *\MEGASync.exe))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\7z[ag]?\.exe$/i regex("(?i)\\s+a\\s+", field=CommandLine) regex("(?i)(\\.zip|\\.7z|\\s-v\\d|\\s-mx|\\s-p)", field=CommandLine) NOT UserName=/\$$/)
| join({
    (#event_simpleName=DnsRequest regex("(?i)(mega\\.co\\.nz|mega\\.nz|userstorage\\.mega\\.co\\.nz|api\\.mega\\.io)", field=DomainName))
    OR (#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(MEGAclient|MEGAsync|megacmdserver|mega-put|rclone)\.exe$/i)
  }, field=aid, limit=20000)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| count > 1
ucs.rationale: MEGA (mega.io / mega.co.nz) is INC Ransom's near-exclusive exfiltration channel — Secureworks, Huntress, and the Yamaha Motor Philippines (May 2024) and NHS Dumfries & Galloway (March 2024) incident reports all document MEGAcmd / `rclone` with a `mega:` remote following 7-Zip multi-volume archive staging on file servers.
